svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 08/12 Golden Gate Park (Common)
svg.desc: The park starts a few blocks down the hill. Big trees, quiet lakes, and room to think. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
